profile.headline: Strategic Ideas
profile.summary:
I am a professional writer, graphic designer, and web developer with over 20 years of experience creating award-winning content and campaigns for a wide variety of industries. I’m part of a three-person team that keeps all websites up to date for a medical center and school of medicine. 

Outside of the office I love writing fiction, learning Ai tools, playing TTRPGs, and spending time with my family.

organizations.name: Society for Health Care Strategy and Market Development (SHSMD)
organizations.description:
Serving more than 4,000 members, the Society for Health Care Strategy & Market Development (SHSMD), a professional membership group of the American Hospital Association, powers the professions of health care, including but not limited to marketing, digital engagement, communications, strategic planning, and business development.

As the largest membership association in its sector, SHSMD helps its members stay at the forefront of health care's rapidly evolving landscape while expanding its members' knowledge and network to create value for the organizations and communities they serve.

organizations.name: Mayo Clinic Social Media Network (MCSMN)
organizations.description:
A professional social network for people and organizations using online digital communication tools to enhance health care delivery and advance careers. #MCSMN

Merged with American Hospital Association's Society for Health Care Strategy and Market Development (SHSMD)
